     Ruoshui Xu
  

  
  


I am a statistics Ph.D. student at Colorado State University. My research combines probability theory, statistical modeling, and data science to address complex problems. Before joining CSU, I received my M.S. in Statistics, M.S. in Environmental and Ecological Engineering from Purdue University and my Bachelor’s degree in Beijing, China.
I am especially interested in using rigorous statistical thinking to solve problems that involve uncertainty and variability. Outside of statistics, I enjoy traveling, writing, photography, and sports. This website is a great space for me to share my acedemics, experiences, and personal interests.
